Wholesale Reusable Champagne Flutes

Classic, ribbed and square champagne flutes from 4.4 oz to 10.8 oz, ready for logo printing and colour matching.

Request champagne flutes pricing Custom logo options

About this range

Champagne service is where breakage hurts most — a dropped flute stops the toast and creates a safety issue on a dance floor. These flutes are moulded in one piece with a reinforced foot and a rolled rim that will not split. The range spans traditional round flutes, ribbed textures that read as premium in photography, and square profiles that stack more efficiently in storage. All styles can be produced in a custom colour and printed with your client's logo.

Champagne Flutes — buyer questions

MOQ is held per SKU/model and per order route for this range — a standard bulk order, a decorated order and a gift-box build can each carry a different minimum.

What does the Champagne Flutes range include?

This range holds 13 items, specified in PS and PP. Orders come most often from wedding and event planners, hotels and ballrooms and wineries and tasting rooms. Each product card states the shape, capacity, material and case pack for that SKU, and the specification table on each product page is the record the quotation is issued against.

See the range · Request a quote

Which champagne flutes styles can be customized?

Customization is confirmed SKU by SKU. Select a flute or coupe style, then provide artwork, quantity, logo position and packaging needs for a feasibility review.

Champagne flutes

Can champagne flutes be supplied for weddings or corporate events?

Event orders can be assessed as standard drinkware, branded drinkware or a gift-set configuration. The applicable MOQ is confirmed against the selected champagne-flute SKU, not the category. Provide the event date, quantity, artwork, packaging and destination.

Weddings and events · Gift box packaging guide

Can I combine champagne flutes with a gift box or greeting card?

A combined set requires confirmation of the selected flute, insert, gift box, logo treatment, card format and outer shipping packaging.

Gift box packaging guide

What should be approved before branded champagne flutes go into production?

Approve the SKU specification, artwork, logo position, decoration method, packaging build, quantity and the final production brief before production begins.

Logo decoration guide
